sources.citation: Isaacs, N. (ed.) et al. (2006). Energy Use in New Zealand Households: Report on the Year 10 Analysis for the Household Energy End-use Project (HEEP). BRANZ Study Report SR155, Judgeford. Table 66 (average annual energy use per house for selected end-uses, gross kWh).

IPCC (2006). 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2 Energy, Chapter 1 Introduction. Table 1.2 (net calorific values) and Table 1.3 (carbon content), row 'Liquefied Petroleum Gases'.
Elgas New Zealand, 'Gas bottle sizes and dimensions' (retrieved 2026-10-14): 45 kg bottles, 'Two of the 45 kg gas bottle size are used for the typical home LPG gas bottle' installation.

items.description: Average annual energy used for cooking per New Zealand house, all cooking appliances and fuels (gross energy)
items.note: 900 kWh (SE 60) is the national 'All cooking' average; 620-1,090 the regional averages. Averaged over all houses and fuels, mostly electric, so it is not a gas-stove figure; ranges use about 50% more in winter than in summer.
